declared.description: Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each UTC day from GTA V's release to the day before GTA 6's, and the running total since GTA V. One row per day.

population.rule: Every UTC day from var gta_v_date (2013-09-17, GTA V's release) to the day before var gta_6_date (2026-11-19, GTA 6's release): 4,811 days.

daily_output.description: World real output on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).

fct_world_output_daily.content:
name: fct_world_output_daily
description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each UTC day from GTA V''s release to the day before GTA 6''s, and the running total since GTA V. One row per day. Population: Every UTC day from var gta_v_date (2013-09-17, GTA V''s release) to the day before var gta_6_date (2026-11-19, GTA 6''s release): 4,811 days.'
model: ref('fct_world_output_daily')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: output_day
entities:
  - name: output_day
    type: primary
    expr: output_day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: output_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: data_year
    type: categorical
    description: Calendar year of output_day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: daily_output
    agg: sum
    expr: daily_output
    description: World real output on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          null_rule: NULL when the year's output is unavailable.
  - name: output_per_second
    agg: max
    expr: output_per_second
    description: 'daily_output / 86400: the rate the world makes things at on the day, a yearly average spread evenly.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          null_rule: NULL when daily_output is.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: cumulative_output
    agg: max
    expr: cumulative_output
    description: Running total of daily_output from GTA V's release through the day. Never sum it across days.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: output_day
      window_choice: max
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          null_rule: 'NULL from the first day with unavailable output on: never a partial total.'
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: 'Every UTC day from var gta_v_date (2013-09-17, GTA V''s release) to the day before var gta_6_date (2026-11-19, GTA 6''s release): 4,811 days.'
      assumptions:
        - decision: Which days the wait holds
          chosen: 2013-09-17 through 2026-11-18, every UTC day
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: bookended by the two releases; GTA 6 unlocks 2026-11-19 00:00 UTC, the site countdown''s moment'
          column: output_day
        - decision: What drives the days
          chosen: a range() of days generated in SQL, not metricflow_time_spine
          evidence: default
          detail: the time spine covers 2025-2027 only; widening it would change a model Metric 1 reads
          column: output_day
        - decision: Running total across an unavailable day
          chosen: NULL from that day on
          evidence: contract
          detail: 'AGENTS.md: a NULL is unavailable, never zero; a total that skipped a year would understate'
          column: cumulative_output
